Completion evidence for AC 'a store whose mapping holds more than one project carries multi-project-bridge':

PRODUCTION: `src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py:163-209` — the ensure backstop converges the `multi-project-bridge` capability stamp onto `.store-compat.json`'s `required_capabilities` exactly when the committed mapping holds >1 project (constant `_MULTI_PROJECT_CAPABILITY` at :44). Registered as a KNOWN capability in `src/rebar/_store/compat.py:63` (`KNOWN_CAPABILITIES`), so the stamp never self-locks-out.

UNIT/INTEGRATION PROOF (all green on main):
- `tests/integration/test_ensure_project_mapping.py::test_multi_project_store_is_stamped` (:201) — asserts `'multi-project-bridge' in caps` after run_ensures on a two-project mapping (REB+DIG).
- `::test_single_project_store_is_not_stamped` (:192) — the negative control (single project → NOT stamped).
- `::test_multi_project_stamped_store_still_passes_compat_gate` (:220) — stamped store still passes `check_store_compat`.
- `tests/unit/test_store_compat_multi_project.py::test_multi_project_bridge_is_registered` (:101).

LIVE PROOF: `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_multi_project_rehearsal.py::test_capability_stamp_and_fail_closed` (:654, assertion :684 `'multi-project-bridge' in record['required_capabilities']`) PASSED in post-merge live DC run 31879125045 (jira DC harness smoke: 73 passed, 1 xfailed).

Merge SHAs: project_ensures.py stamping @ 72731d3745; integration tests reachable from current main HEAD.
